name: Elders Communications
summary: Internet/telco arm of the Elders agribusiness (late 1990s, elders.net.au, ACN 117 261 864); services discontinued.

events.details: Services discontinued. Elders' retail internet operations formally closed 1 Aug 2008 with customers moved to Harbour IT and People Telecom — c.2003 was far too early.

refs.label: official closure notice after the OPEL funding failure (1 Apr 2008); customers transitioned 1 Aug 2008
elders.net.au itself was Elders' agribusiness portal, not the retail ISP front (telco retail ran on elderstelecommunications.com.au)
ABR: ELDERS COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD ACN 117 261 864
